idCode.description: Code uniquely identifying a Transaction Set.

controlNumber.description:
Identifying control number that must be unique within the transaction set functional group
assigned by the originator for a transaction set.

implConventionReference.description: Reference assigned to identify Implementation convention.

hierarchStructCd.description:
Code indicating the hierarchial application structure of a transaction set that utilizes
the HL segment to define the structure of the transaction set.

tsPurposeCd.description: Code identifying purpose of transaction set.

referenceIdentification.description:
Reference information as defined for a particular Transaction Set or
as specified by the Reference Identification Qualifier.

date.description: Date expressed as CCYYMMDD where CC represents the first two digits of the calendar year.

transactionTypeCd.description: Code specifying the type of transaction.

title:
Document meta contains control number, data that indicates transaction set start and end, count of the transmitted segments,
details on business hierarchial structure of the transaction set and business application purpose,
and reference data.
Including segments BHT and ST. Values from SR segment are not included, only validated.
name: X12DocumentMeta
